Plainly: TripDesk will not refund any part of the EUR 540 for your Amalfi stay AME10B. The stay was booked at a non-refundable rate, and the property's policy keeps a late cancellation fee of EUR 540, the whole stay. Your bank's chargeback on that EUR 540 payment was decided in TripDesk's favour and is closed, and TripDesk refunds nothing outside that decision. Your waiver request of 24 October is on file, but it was a request, not a promise from anyone. Your flight LHE10A was cancelled for an extraordinary event, so no EU261 compensation is due on it either. As you asked, I have not opened a case with the hotel, Lufthansa or anyone else.

grade.message: Our Lufthansa flight Warsaw to Naples (LHE10A) was cancelled because of the Etna eruption. I told the hotel (AME10B) straight away and they still refused to waive anything and marked us as a no-show. My bank refused the chargeback because the hotel was open. Lufthansa already gave the flight money back. I want the 540 euros for the hotel back, it is not our fault a volcano erupted! If it is not something you owe me, just tell me plainly, I do not want a case opened with anyone. agnieszka.nowak@example.com, card 6010.
